newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls to 576c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls to 576c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eased further at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne on Wednesday, with the eastern market indicator falling four cents to 576 cents a kg clean, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, 19 micron was slightly dearer while 20 mm was up to 2.5 percent cheaper and 21 mm was one percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings were mixed, with 18.5 mm and finer two percent dearer, 19 mm firm, and 20/23/24 mm up to three percent cheaper in Melbourne.
In crossbreds, 27m was one percent cheaper and the remainder were 0.5 percent cheaper.
Italy and other Western Europe buyers dominated trade with good support from other sectors, WI said.
Of the 22,733 bales offered, 13.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Newcastle, Melbourne, and Fremantle with about 41,400 bales to be offered.
